what: the JevAgentRL-v2 rows of Stage 2 (docs/PREREG_A7_STAGE2.md A7.19 (f); exploratory, descriptive, outside every Holm table) as scripts/aws/stage2_gpu.sh stages v2_* serve and run them; written from results/gpu_round6_miles/final_FROZEN.txt and committed before the v2 chain
label: exploratory (A7.19)

checkpoint.stage: sft_v2 (frozen = SFT v2 on StartLux-Decision-4B, full fine-tune exported to Hugging Face format; results/gpu_round6_miles/chain_decision.json)
checkpoint.calibration_note: the freeze record's temperature file (training/calibrate.py --min-bucket 200 on v1 dev, gpu_round6_stages.sh stage freeze; identical to results/gpu_round6_miles/final_calibration.json); every v2 row is served with it, as the frozen JevAgentRL is served with its own
checkpoint.sha256_from: the freeze record's sha256 lines (results/gpu_round6_miles/final_FROZEN.txt); the downloaded FROZEN.txt must be byte-identical to it

serving_env.why: StartLux-Decision-4B is a Qwen3.5 hybrid (linear attention): serve_jev needs the flash-linear-attention and causal-conv1d kernels for a usable speed. The harness venv (/opt/jev/hvenv, Intern-Decision in-process, the runner) and the StartLux vendor environment (/opt/startlux/venv, A7.18 (d) manifest) are left untouched; the v2 venv is the harness venv's stack plus the kernels.
serving_env.constraints: uv pip freeze of /opt/jev/hvenv without the harness, torch, triton and nvidia-* lines (recorded as results/stage2/gpu/v2/v2venv_constraints.txt)
serving_env.kernel_versions_source: the StartLux vendor environment on the same host (results/stage2/startlux_manifest.json: flash-linear-attention 0.5.2, causal-conv1d 1.7.0, torch 2.14.1, CUDA 13 toolkit)
serving_env.causal_conv1d_wheel: the host's own build of causal_conv1d-1.7.0-cp311 (pip wheel cache of the StartLux setup) if present, else built with --no-build-isolation against the CUDA toolkit of torch's CUDA major version, as scripts/aws/serve_startlux.sh does
serving_env.check: transformers' Qwen3.5 module binds the kernel implementations (causal_conv1d_fn / causal_conv1d_update / chunk and recurrent gated delta rule are not the torch fallbacks) and both kernels run on the GPU (jevharness.training.miles_port.smoke kernel_check); else the stage fails

regression.what: before the first request: the serving path's option probabilities of the frozen model on the freeze's 64-row regression corpus, on this host and environment, compared with the freeze-time files of the checkpoint (regression_image.json: the Miles image with the kernels, transformers 5.12.1; regression_venv.json: the Miles host's project venv, transformers 5.18.0)
regression.rule: the host must reproduce the image's probabilities within the freeze's tolerance (max |dprob| <= 0.02, as results/gpu_round6_miles/final_regression_compare.json), else nothing is served; the comparison with regression_venv.json is recorded beside it

system1_caches.evaluation: cache/s1_stage2_v2.sqlite (new: calibration, live replace and profile rows)

api.what: A7.19 (g): the track's API cap is a ceiling. The rows' Flash spend is summed from every record (errored attempts included) of the runs below before each priced stage; a stage whose reserve would cross cap_rows_usd does not start
api.cap_note: A7.19 (g): <= $100 API for the whole track; the training chain's ledger (scripts/train/r6_spend.py) was $42.43 before its final E2 dev slice (results/gpu_round6_miles/spend_before_e2dev_v2_final.txt), so ~$45 remains for the rows (planned ~$35); the session may lower this before the chain, never raise it past $100 minus the training ledger
